correction: chairlift was counted as started from a `chairlift --first-run` process. Only the user journal line `first-run: window presented` proves a presented window, so a bare --first-run process no longer counts, and first-setup keeps the two-consecutive-polls rule.

correction: SDDM and GLib strip whitespace around '=' and around a section name, but login-setup.sh and login_autologin matched only the exact text 'User=' and an exact section header, so an active `User = other` in /etc/sddm.conf, a spaced drop-in key or a spaced GDM `AutomaticLogin = snowqa` was read wrongly. Both sides now parse a section header with surrounding whitespace stripped and each active line as key, '=', value with whitespace stripped (keys case-sensitive), and the GDM check reads [daemon] only.

The SDDM probe reported autologin false only for an active User key in /etc/sddm.conf [Autologin], but SDDM reads that file after /etc/sddm.conf.d, so an active Session or Relogin key there also wins over the drop-in; autologin is now false for any of User, Session and Relogin in that section, and README and ADR-0016 state the same rule.
